summary: Keep unrelated step transitions from invalidating every seat's work wake

replay.detail: No replay. Work reads register every candidate step before visibility filtering; generation creation still invalidates work membership, and handoffs also mark their new recipient. Revision-proposal creation, approval and cancellation retain collection dependencies because their receipts change run visibility on a proposal subject.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers change.

rules.detail: Work selection, claims, readiness, lease deadlines and handoff acknowledgment rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No API or claim shape changes. This changes only the daemon's in-memory reconcile dependency keys.

recovery.detail: Revert the dependency-key change to restore broad step-state invalidation.
